agentFiles.change: a new file: what agents do before they push

edits.diff:
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -2,6 +2,13 @@
   "name": "shop",
   "private": true,
   "scripts": {
-    "test": "vitest run --reporter=junit --outputFile=junit.xml"
+    "test": "hushrun run -- vitest run --reporter=junit --outputFile=junit.xml",
+    "prepare": "hushrun hook install || exit 0"
+  },
+  "hushrun": {
+    "backend": "<your org's URL, once you sign in>"
+  },
+  "devDependencies": {
+    "hushrun": "^<version>"
   }
 }

--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -9,6 +9,11 @@
       matrix:
         node: [20, 22]
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
+    env:
+      HUSHRUN_VARIANT: ${{ toJSON(matrix) }}
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
       - run: npm ci

scripts.ciText: a later step reads its reports (dorny/test-reporter), and a skip writes none

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
CI runs test every time: a later step reads its reports (dorny/test-reporter). Laptops and agents skip it on a pass.
